title: Mary Queen of Scots to the Duke of Norfolk, 'the 20th' [Feb or Mar 1570], BL Cotton MS Caligula C II f. 74r

steps.what: BL IIIF manifest found via searcharchives; 1024-px tiles stitched to full resolution.
Tomokiyo's key checked on f. 66r against its contemporary decipherment.
Key applied to 23 line strips; all lines read, five nomenclator signs and a few groups open.
Content dated after Moray's murder (Jan 1570): Morton rumour, Lord Talbot, Elizabeth's blame.

Novelty re-examined. G. Lasry (21 Sept 2026): on cryptiana 'undeciphered' means no interlinear or nearby deciphered copy, not unsolved; unsolved material is on the unsolved page. The key was available (Tomokiyo); the contribution is the transcription and the reading.

outcome.notes: Open: five unkeyed signs, two groups in line 1, stained end of line 4, single words.

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
